consequence_description: Pro-forma mediation scheduling where parties attend solely to avoid bad-faith sanctions rather than negotiate.
cost_transfer_or_inequality: Time/delay cost transferred to parties when non-certified judges rush sessions.
institutional_burden: Mediators compressed by 30-day timeline and regular trial dockets.

consequence_description: Mandatory direct attendance and same-domicile rules create travel/representation friction for out-of-district plaintiffs.
cost_transfer_or_inequality: Cost transferred to out-of-region plaintiffs needing local representatives.
institutional_burden: Court verification of representative assignment letters.

consequence_description: High e-Court filing share (99.65% PN) coexisted initially with low e-Litigation trial completion (4.58% in 2020) and PA lag (30.78% in 2023).
cost_transfer_or_inequality: Digital literacy & connectivity gap between PN and PA/regional users.
institutional_burden: Shortage of dedicated e-Court file administrators at court level.

consequence_description: IT/network disruptions during remote criminal hearings trigger mandatory suspension (>60 min) and rescheduling.
cost_transfer_or_inequality: Delay risk in detention-sensitive criminal trials.
institutional_burden: Parallel verification of digital vs manual case records.

consequence_description: DIPA budget ceiling constraints can cap Prodeo fee-waiver availability mid-year, while indigence document verification (SKTM/social-assistance cards) introduces administrative friction.
cost_transfer_or_inequality: Geographic and fiscal variation across court DIPA allocations.
institutional_burden: Administrative verification and quarterly Posbakum M&E reporting on court registrars.

consequence_description: Non-binding Pasal 25 culpability indicators produce uneven evidentiary standards across courts, while pre-verdict corporate dissolution or asset transfers hinder execution of fines and restitution.
cost_transfer_or_inequality: Risk of unrecovered state/victim losses when shell or dissolved corporations evade fine execution.
institutional_burden: Complex asset-tracing and post-verdict collection hurdles for prosecutors and courts.

consequence_description: Most civil environmental restoration judgments remain unenforced at execution, and replacing SK KMA 036/2013 omitted its explicit Polluter Pays Principle definition.
cost_transfer_or_inequality: Ecological restoration costs remain externalized onto affected communities when judgments go unexecuted.
institutional_burden: Complex post-judgment asset attachment and restoration monitoring by PN and KLHK.
